jobs.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and HealthTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building multiple SaaS platforms across AI, healthcare, and data intelligence. Their core product is a multi-tenant AI-powered platform designed to enhance sales intelligence and call analysis, alongside a HIPAA-aware healthcare portal and a growing audience intelligence platform.

They operate in a highly technical, product-driven environment focused on scalability, clean architecture, and efficient execution.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We are hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer to work across multiple SaaS applications, contributing to feature development, integrations, debugging, and backend systems.

This is a high-impact remote engineering role where you’ll split your time across products based on sprint priorities, with a primary focus on an AI-driven platform. You’ll be responsible for executing scoped tasks with precision while also contributing to more complex systems and integrations.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Sales Intelligence Platform (Primary Focus – ~70%)
    • Build and implement features from architectural specifications
    • Develop modern UI components, dashboards, and workflows using React and Next.js
    • Build and maintain API routes with validation, pagination, and error handling
    • Debug and maintain third-party integrations and APIs
    • Implement webhook pipelines and asynchronous data workflows
    • Manage background jobs and workflow orchestration
    • Contribute to database design, migrations, and row-level security (RLS) policies
    • Write unit and integration tests to ensure system reliability
  • Healthcare B2B Platform (~30%)
    • Develop onboarding flows and role-based interfaces
    • Build and maintain authentication systems
    • Integrate with third-party healthcare and pharmacy APIs
    • Implement validation, audit logging, and compliance-aware features
    • Troubleshoot bugs and improve system workflows
  • Additional Product Work (As Needed)
    • Support feature enhancements and maintenance for a stable audience intelligence platform
  • General Responsibilities
    • Execute development tasks with high reliability and attention to detail
    • Collaborate through Git-based workflows, PR reviews, and structured documentation
    • Troubleshoot API, integration, and system-level issues
    • Use AI tools to improve development efficiency and output quality

Requirements

Core Technical Skills

  • 2–4+ years of experience with TypeScript (strict mode, generics, strong typing)
  • Strong experience with Next.js (App Router, API routes, middleware)
  • Proficiency in React with modern component architecture
  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL (queries, joins, schema design, RLS)
  • Experience with Supabase or similar BaaS platforms (auth, database, storage, edge functions)

Technical Experience

  • REST API integrations and debugging
  • Handling third-party API inconsistencies and failures
  • Webhooks and asynchronous data processing
  • Background jobs and workflow orchestration
  • Git workflows (feature branches, pull requests, code reviews)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms
  • Exposure to AI or voice-based systems
  • Experience working with HIPAA-compliant or regulated environments
  • Strong understanding of system design and integration patterns

How You’ll Work

  • Async-first communication environment
  • Documentation-driven development
  • All code reviewed via pull requests before merging
  • Strong focus on clean, reliable execution over unnecessary complexity
  • Collaborative team culture with encouragement to ask questions early

Growth Opportunity

  • Increased ownership across systems and architecture
  • Opportunity to lead projects and step into senior responsibilities
  • Exposure to multiple SaaS products across AI, healthcare, and data platforms

Ideal Candidate

  • Detail-oriented and highly reliable
  • Strong problem-solver, especially in debugging complex systems
  • Comfortable working independently within structured systems
  • Clear and proactive communicator
  • Able to balance speed with high-quality output

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and region

🌎 Fully remote role with flexible working environment

🚀 Work on cutting-edge AI and multi-product SaaS platforms

📈 Long-term growth with opportunities for leadership and ownership

🧠 Exposure to complex systems, integrations, and scalable architectures

🎯 High-impact role contributing directly to product development

AI Developer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Mountain Time

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an AI Developer to help build the next generation of AI-powered solutions as they transition into a native-AI agency.

This is a hands-on role focused on designing, building, and maintaining AI agents using modern AI development tools and automation frameworks. You’ll own projects from scoping through deployment, working closely with leadership to build scalable, production-ready AI systems.

If you enjoy building AI agents, solving complex problems, and taking ownership of technical decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent Development

  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents that power the company’s transition to a native-AI agency.
  • Own the full development lifecycle from scoping through deployment.
  • Monitor agent performance, identify failures, and continuously improve AI capabilities.

Tooling & Orchestration

  • Build reliable AI workflows using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Inngest.
  • Develop scalable automation pipelines and event-driven workflows.

Backend & Data Layer

  • Develop and manage solutions using Supabase.
  • Build and maintain database schemas, authentication, and real-time functionality to support AI agents.

Technical Ownership

  • Take full ownership of AI architecture, tooling decisions, and production quality.
  • Work independently while making technical decisions with minimal oversight.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 1 year of professional experience building AI agents or AI-powered applications.
  • Experience with Claude Code and/or OpenAI Codex for AI development and code generation.
  • Working knowledge of Inngest for event-driven orchestration and background jobs.
  • Hands-on experience with Supabase, including database design, authentication, and real-time features.
  • Comfortable working independently as the primary AI developer.
  • Availability to work U.S. Mountain Time (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM).

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and proactively identify what needs to be built.
  • You’re comfortable working in a fast-changing environment with evolving requirements.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively, especially when blocked or shipping new work.
  • You focus on practical, working solutions and know when to prototype versus optimize.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review AI agent logs and resolve production issues.
  • Build new AI agents and extend Inngest workflows.
  • Develop and maintain Supabase databases and integrations.
  • Participate in standups or async team updates.
  • Document completed work and communicate technical decisions.
  • Own projects from design through deployment without handoffs.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. AI Technical Assessment
  4. Recruiter Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and discuss your experience building AI agents, working with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Inngest, and Supabase, and solving real-world technical challenges. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward to the next stage.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re excited about building AI agents, owning technical decisions, and helping shape the future of an AI-first company, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today to join a fast-moving team building production-ready AI solutions.

jobs.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth.
jobs.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the role

WarriorBabe is seeking an Analytics Engineer who can own the reliability and performance of our Supabase/PostgreSQL database and turn business data into clear, actionable insights.

You will maintain data integrations and refresh processes, develop reliable data models, and build useful Metabase dashboards. You will also work directly with leadership and business teams to investigate performance, explain what is driving results, identify opportunities, and recommend measurable actions.

You will help evaluate and improve our data architecture as the business evolves. We welcome recommendations grounded in business needs, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost.

Success means keeping the data accurate, current, and well documented—and using it to help the business make better decisions.

Key Responsibilites

Database ownership and performance

  • Manage and improve our Supabase/PostgreSQL reporting database, including tables, views, materialized views, indexes, and SQL queries.
  • Diagnose slow queries, blocking, failed refreshes, and resource bottlenecks; use evidence to prioritize improvements.
  • Maintain appropriate permissions, review schema changes, and support backup and recovery readiness.
  • Plan and validate database changes with clear dependency checks, migration steps, and rollback procedures.
  • Evaluate the existing architecture and recommend practical improvements while preserving reporting continuity.

Data integrations and n8n

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production n8n workflows used for data ingestion, synchronization, and reporting.
  • Maintain Fivetran connections and custom API integrations, with clear ownership of each source, writer, destination, and downstream dependency.
  • Work with CRM, ERM, and other business systems as required.
  • Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, retries, and safe backfills.
  • Monitor actual data delivery and freshness, including failures that may be hidden behind a successful workflow or scheduler status.

Data modeling and reporting reliability

  • Develop reusable SQL models with clear record definitions, keys, relationships, and treatment of historical changes.
  • Maintain agreed definitions for revenue, clients, conversion, refunds, renewals, retention, and other business metrics.
  • Reconcile reporting with its underlying sources and distinguish missing data from a verified zero.
  • Prevent duplicate counts and inconsistent totals across dashboards, including differences caused by dates, time zones, attribution, or counting rules.
  • Document data lineage, metric definitions, refresh behavior, known limitations, and operating procedures.

Metabase dashboards

  • Build and maintain Metabase dashboards, saved questions, filters, and record-level drill-throughs.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into reporting that supports a specific business decision.
  • Verify saved configuration and the dashboard users actually see, including filters, totals, drill-throughs, and links to operational records.
  • Maintain documentation alongside analytical dashboards and preserve dependent reports when making changes.

Business analysis and insights

  • Proactively analyze acquisition, sales conversion, revenue, refunds, renewals, retention, and coaching performance.
  • Investigate performance changes by relevant cohorts, products, channels, teams, and time periods.
  • Distinguish business changes from data-quality problems and clearly separate evidence, hypotheses, and remaining uncertainty.
  • Present findings with their business impact, recommended action, and a practical way to measure the result.
  • Partner with business owners to evaluate whether actions taken improved outcomes.

AI-assisted development and analysis

  • Use AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, n8n workflow design, troubleshooting, documentation, and business analysis.
  • Use AI to explore patterns, develop hypotheses, review queries and calculations, and identify potential errors or edge cases.
  • Validate AI-generated code, calculations, and conclusions against source data and reproducible checks before deploying changes or presenting findings.
  • Protect confidential information and protected health information (PHI) when using AI, following company policies and using approved tools.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on ownership of a production PostgreSQL or Supabase database, including troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation, query plans, and indexing.
  • Practical experience building and troubleshooting production n8n workflows. Be prepared to explain a workflow you personally implemented and how it handled failures.
  • Experience with API integrations, webhooks, authentication, pagination, rate limits, and reliable synchronization.
  • Experience with Metabase or a comparable BI platform, with the ability to work hands-on in Metabase.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate business performance, quantify findings, and recommend actions.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to build, improve, analyze, and check work, with the ability to explain and independently verify the results.
  • Ability to explain technical issues and business conclusions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience using Git and maintaining clear technical documentation and controlled production changes.

Preferred Experience

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and the privacy and security considerations involved in handling protected health information (PHI) across databases, integrations, and reporting.
  • CRM and ERM data structures, relationships, and integrations.
  • Fivetran configuration and monitoring.
  • Payment, subscription, refund, renewal, or customer-retention reporting.
  • Python or JavaScript for scripting and automation.
  • Experience with Metabase for understanding and reconciling existing reports.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business teams can understand what key metrics mean and trace results to supporting records.
  • Data integrations and reporting refreshes operate within agreed freshness and completeness expectations, with actionable monitoring.
  • Database and dashboard improvements have documented validation and preserve dependent reporting.
  • Leadership receives useful explanations and recommendations, with follow-up on the actions taken.
  • Architecture recommendations include their benefits, tradeoffs, costs, and a practical implementation path.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote work with flexibility and Eastern Time overlap.
  • Ownership across the database, integrations, reporting, and business analysis.
  • Direct collaboration with business leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions.
  • An environment that values precision, clear communication, and practical improvements.
